name: AgentFolders
description: Adds a fixed-agent Assignee filter to the paid Custom Folders module (ARMS-46), so an admin can create a folder that always shows one specific agent's conversations, regardless of who is viewing it. Custom Folders' own "Show only own conversations" setting resolves to whoever is logged in, so it cannot pin a folder to a named agent - this module adds that on top via Eventy filters plus two small patches to Custom Folders' form and controller (Console/PatchCustomFoldersAssignee.php).
author: Threls
